data.gender_notes: Faiqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘faiqa’ which means ‘bright’, ‘luminous’, or ‘shining’. It is often used to describe a person who is intelligent, clear-minded, and radiant in their outlook on life. The name Faiqa carries the meaning “Bright, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faiqa usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
